name: FUS DNA/RNA binding protein

function.text: FUS encodes RNA-binding protein FUS. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coactivator activity and transcription coregulator activity. It participates in RNA splicing and regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 6 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Liposarcoma; Rhabdomyosarcoma; NFATC2-rearranged sarcoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
